name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.regular_finite
statement:
lemma regular_finite {L : Language Alphabet} (hL : (L : Set (List Alphabet)).Finite) :
    L.IsRegular

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.regular_singleton
statement: lemma regular_singleton (w : List Alphabet) : ({w} : Language Alphabet).IsRegular

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.regular_finset_iSup
statement:
lemma regular_finset_iSup {I : Type uI} (s : Finset I) (L : I → Language Alphabet)
    (h : ∀ i∈s, (L i).IsRegular) : (⨆ i∈s,L i).IsRegular

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.regular_iSup
statement:
lemma regular_iSup {I : Type uI2} [Finite I] (L : I → Language Alphabet)
    (h : ∀ i, (L i).IsRegular) : (⨆ i,L i).IsRegular

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.regular_recognized
statement:
lemma regular_recognized {M : Type uM} [Monoid M] [Fintype M]
    (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) (F : Set M) :
    Language.IsRegular ({w | T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)∈F} : Language Alphabet)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.regular_sandwich
statement:
lemma regular_sandwich [Finite Alphabet] {M : Type uM2} [Monoid M] [Fintype M]
    (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) (N tail : ℕ) (L : Language Alphabet)
    (hc : ∀ (a b x y : List Alphabet), a.length=N → b.length=tail →
      T (FreeMonoid.ofList x)=T (FreeMonoid.ofList y) →
      (a++x++b∈L ↔ a++y++b∈L)) : L.IsRegular

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.matcher
statement:
noncomputable def matcher (v : ZMod p → Alphabet) : DFA Alphabet (Option (ZMod p)) := by
  classical
  exact ⟨fun q a => q.bind (fun i => if a=v i then some (i+1) else none),some 0, {q | q.isSome}⟩

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.Fits
statement:
def Fits (v : ZMod p → Alphabet) : ZMod p → List Alphabet → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | q, a::w => a=v q ∧ Fits v (q+1) w

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.eval_none
statement:
lemma eval_none (v : ZMod p → Alphabet) (w : List Alphabet) :
    (matcher v).evalFrom none w=none

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.eval_isSome
statement:
lemma eval_isSome (v : ZMod p → Alphabet) (w : List Alphabet) (q : ZMod p) :
    ((matcher v).evalFrom (some q) w).isSome ↔ Fits v q w

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.fits_iff
statement:
lemma fits_iff (v : ZMod p → Alphabet) (w : List Alphabet) (q : ZMod p) :
    Fits v q w ↔ ∀ i : Fin w.length, w[i.val]=v (q+i.val)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.transition
statement:
noncomputable def transition : FreeMonoid Alphabet →*
    ((ZMod p → Alphabet) → (Function.End (Option (ZMod p)))ᵐᵒᵖ) :=
  MonoidHom.pi (fun v => FiniteRecognition.transition (matcher v))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.fits_congr
OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.lengthMod
statement:
def lengthMod (n : ℕ) : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* Multiplicative (ZMod n) where
  toFun w := Multiplicative.ofAdd (w.toList.length:ZMod n)
  map_one' := by simp only [FreeMonoid.toList_one,List.length_nil,Nat.cast_zero]; rfl
  map_mul' x y := by
    change Multiplicative.ofAdd ((x.toList++y.toList).length:ZMod n)=_
    simp only [List.length_append,Nat.cast_add]
    rfl

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicSummary.lengthMod_dvd
OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.splice
statement:
noncomputable def splice (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (N : ℤ) (x y : List Alphabet) (z : ℤ) : Alphabet :=
  if h : z<N then f z else if h' : z<N+y.length then
    y[(z-N).toNat]'(by omega) else f (z-((y.length:ℤ)-x.length))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.splice_left
statement:
lemma splice_left (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (N : ℤ) (x y : List Alphabet) {z : ℤ} (hz : z<N) :
    splice f N x y z=f z

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.splice_right
statement:
lemma splice_right (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (N : ℤ) (x y : List Alphabet) {z : ℤ}
    (hz : N+y.length≤z) : splice f N x y z=f (z-((y.length:ℤ)-x.length))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.splice_middle
statement:
lemma splice_middle (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (N : ℤ) (x y : List Alphabet) :
    Realizes y N (splice f N x y)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.splice_realizes
OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame
statement:
structure Frame (f f' : ℤ → Alphabet) (N : ℤ) (x y : List Alphabet) : Prop where
  left : ∀ z, z<N → f' z=f z
  oldMiddle : Realizes x N f
  newMiddle : Realizes y N f'
  right : ∀ z, N+y.length≤z → f' z=f (z-((y.length:ℤ)-x.length))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.left
statement: left : ∀ z, z<N → f' z=f z

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.oldMiddle
statement: oldMiddle : Realizes x N f

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.newMiddle
statement: newMiddle : Realizes y N f'

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.right
statement: right : ∀ z, N+y.length≤z → f' z=f (z-((y.length:ℤ)-x.length))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.splice_frame
OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.agrees_left
statement: lemma agrees_left {s t : ℤ} (ht : t≤N) : AgreesOn f f' s t
variables: variable {f f' : ℤ → Alphabet} {N : ℤ} {x y : List Alphabet} (H : Frame f f' N x y)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.piece_left
statement: lemma piece_left {s t : ℤ} (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t≤N) : piece f s t=piece f' s t
variables: variable {f f' : ℤ → Alphabet} {N : ℤ} {x y : List Alphabet} (H : Frame f f' N x y)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.piece_right
statement:
lemma piece_right {s t : ℤ} (hs : N+x.length ≤ s) :
    piece f' (s+((y.length:ℤ)-x.length)) (t+((y.length:ℤ)-x.length))=piece f s t
variables: variable {f f' : ℤ → Alphabet} {N : ℤ} {x y : List Alphabet} (H : Frame f f' N x y)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamSplice.Frame.product
statement:
lemma product {M : Type uM3} [Monoid M] (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M)
    (hT : T (FreeMonoid.ofList x)=T (FreeMonoid.ofList y)) {s b : ℤ}
    (hs : s≤N) (hb : N+x.length≤b) :
    WordIntervals.product T f' s (b+((y.length:ℤ)-x.length))=WordIntervals.product T f s b
variables: variable {f f' : ℤ → Alphabet} {N : ℤ} {x y : List Alphabet} (H : Frame f f' N x y)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.vertices
statement:
def vertices : List (P × P) → Finset P
  | [] => ∅
  | e :: es => insert e.1 (insert e.2 (vertices es))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.FreshPairs
statement:
def FreshPairs : List (P × P) → Prop
  | [] => True
  | e :: es => e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ (e.1 ∉ vertices es ∨ e.2 ∉ vertices es) ∧ FreshPairs es

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.mem_vertices
statement:
lemma mem_vertices {es : List (P × P)} {e : P × P} (he : e ∈ es) :
    e.1 ∈ vertices es ∧ e.2 ∈ vertices es

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.card_vertices
statement: lemma card_vertices (es : List (P × P)) : (vertices es).card ≤ 2 * es.length

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.FreshPairs.nodup
statement: lemma FreshPairs.nodup {es : List (P × P)} (h : FreshPairs es) : es.Nodup

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.FreshPairs.realize
statement:
lemma FreshPairs.realize {A : Type uA} [AddCommGroup A]
    {es : List (P × P)} (h : FreshPairs es) (d : P × P → A) :
    ∃ v : P → A, ∀ e ∈ es, v e.2 - v e.1 = d e

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.realize_sequence
statement:
lemma realize_sequence {A : Type uA2} [AddCommGroup A] {F : ℕ} (f : Fin F → P × P)
    (hf : FreshPairs (List.ofFn f)) (d : Fin F → A) :
    ∃ v : P → A, ∀ j, v (f j).2 - v (f j).1 = d j

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.extract_forest
statement:
lemma extract_forest (B : Finset (P × P)) (hB : ∀ e ∈ B, e.1 ≠ e.2)
    (F : ℕ) (hcard : 4 * F ^ 2 < B.card) :
    ∃ f : Fin F → P × P, FreshPairs (List.ofFn f) ∧ ∀ j, f j ∈ B

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.count_of_no_forest
statement:
lemma count_of_no_forest (B : Finset (P × P)) (hB : ∀ e ∈ B, e.1 ≠ e.2)
    (F : ℕ) (hn : ∀ f : Fin F → P × P, FreshPairs (List.ofFn f) →
      ∃ j, f j ∉ B) : B.card ≤ 4 * F ^ 2

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.Circle
statement: abbrev Circle := UnitAddCircle

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.coe_integer
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_integer (k : ℤ) : (((k : ℝ) : Circle)) = 0

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.representative
statement: lemma representative (a : Circle) : ∃ r : ℝ, (r : Circle) = a ∧ |r| = ‖a‖

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.norm_coe_le_abs
statement: lemma norm_coe_le_abs (r : ℝ) : ‖(r : Circle)‖ ≤ |r|

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.coe_mod_fraction
statement:
lemma coe_mod_fraction (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℤ) :
    ((((k % (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) / n : ℝ) : Circle) = (((k : ℝ) / n : ℝ) : Circle)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.grid_near
statement:
lemma grid_near (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (a : Circle) :
    ∃ j : Fin n, ‖a + (((j : ℝ) / n : ℝ) : Circle)‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * n)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.Near
statement:
def Near (C : Set Circle) (r : ℝ) : Set Circle :=
  {x | ∃ c ∈ C, dist x c ≤ r}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.centersI
statement:
def centersI : Set Circle := {((0 : ℝ) : Circle), ((1 / 6 : ℝ) : Circle),
  ((3 / 6 : ℝ) : Circle)}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.centersJ
statement:
def centersJ : Set Circle := {((2 / 6 : ℝ) : Circle), ((4 / 6 : ℝ) : Circle),
  ((5 / 6 : ℝ) : Circle)}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.center_separation
statement:
lemma center_separation {c d : Circle} (hc : c ∈ centersI) (hd : d ∈ centersJ) :
    1 / 6 ≤ dist c d

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.center_sums
statement:
lemma center_sums (j : Fin 6) : ∃ c ∈ centersI, ∃ d ∈ centersJ,
    c + d = (((j : ℝ) / 6 : ℝ) : Circle)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.type_one_difference
OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.type_one_interior
statement:
lemma type_one_interior (z : Circle) :
    ∃ i j : Circle, i + j = z ∧ ∀ h : Circle, ‖h‖ ≤ 1 / 96 →
      i + h ∈ Near centersI (1 / 16) ∧ j - h ∈ Near centersJ (1 / 16)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.smallCoords
statement:
noncomputable def smallCoords {C : Type uC} [Fintype C] (x : C → Circle) (r : ℝ) : Finset C := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun c => ‖x c‖ ≤ r)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.mem_smallCoords
statement:
lemma mem_smallCoords {C : Type uC2} [Fintype C] (x : C → Circle) (r : ℝ) (c : C) :
    c ∈ smallCoords x r ↔ ‖x c‖ ≤ r

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.TypeTwo
statement:
def TypeTwo {C : Type uC3} [Fintype C] (s : ℕ) : Set (C → Circle) :=
  {x | s + 1 ≤ (smallCoords x (1 / 100)).card}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.type_two_difference
statement:
lemma type_two_difference {C : Type uC4} [Fintype C] (s : ℕ)
    (hC : Fintype.card C = 2 * s + 1) {i j : C → Circle}
    (hi : i ∈ TypeTwo s) (hj : j ∈ TypeTwo s) :
    ∃ c, ‖i c - j c‖ ≤ 2 / 100

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.type_two_interior
statement:
lemma type_two_interior {C : Type uC5} [Fintype C] (s : ℕ)
    (hC : Fintype.card C = 2 * s + 1) (z : C → Circle)
    (hz : ∃ c, ‖z c‖ ≤ 1 / 200) :
    ∃ i j : C → Circle, i + j = z ∧ ∀ h : C → Circle,
      (∀ c, ‖h c‖ ≤ 1 / 400) → i + h ∈ TypeTwo s ∧ j - h ∈ TypeTwo s

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.FirstI
statement:
def FirstI (ε : ℝ) (side : Bool) : Set Circle :=
  if side then {i | 4 * ε ≤ ‖i‖} else {i | ‖i‖ ≤ ε}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.FirstJ
statement:
def FirstJ (ε : ℝ) (side : Bool) : Set Circle :=
  if side then {j | ‖j‖ ≤ ε} else {j | 4 * ε ≤ ‖j‖}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.first_left_right
statement:
lemma first_left_right {ε : ℝ} {i j : Circle}
    (hi : i ∈ FirstI ε false) (hj : j ∈ FirstJ ε true) : ‖i + j‖ ≤ 2 * ε

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.first_same_side
statement:
lemma first_same_side {ε : ℝ} (side : Bool) {i j : Circle}
    (hi : i ∈ FirstI ε side) (hj : j ∈ FirstJ ε side) : 3 * ε ≤ ‖i + j‖

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.first_interior
statement:
lemma first_interior {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (side : Bool) (z : Circle)
    (hz : 6 * ε < ‖z‖) : ∃ i j : Circle, i + j = z ∧
      ∀ h : Circle, ‖h‖ ≤ ε / 2 → i + h ∈ FirstI ε side ∧ j - h ∈ FirstJ ε side

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.pow_two_half
statement:
lemma pow_two_half {a b : ℕ} (h : a < b) :
    2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ b

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.pow_two_pos_diff_inj
statement:
lemma pow_two_pos_diff_inj {a b c d : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hcd : c < d)
    (h : (2 : ℝ) ^ b - 2 ^ a = 2 ^ d - 2 ^ c) : a = c ∧ b = d

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.pow_two_diff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma pow_two_diff_ne_zero {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ b - 2 ^ a ≠ 0

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.pow_two_diff_inj
statement:
lemma pow_two_diff_inj {a b c d : ℕ} (hab : a ≠ b) (_hcd : c ≠ d)
    (h : (2 : ℝ) ^ b - 2 ^ a = 2 ^ d - 2 ^ c) : a = c ∧ b = d

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.realRoster
statement:
noncomputable def realRoster [Fintype P] (p : P) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.equivFin P p).val / (16 * 2 ^ Fintype.card P)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.realRoster_range
statement: lemma realRoster_range [Fintype P] (p : P) : 0 < realRoster p ∧ realRoster p < 1 / 16

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.realRoster_diff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma realRoster_diff_ne_zero [Fintype P] {p q : P} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    realRoster q - realRoster p ≠ 0

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.realRoster_diff_inj
statement:
lemma realRoster_diff_inj [Fintype P] {p q r s : P} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (h : realRoster q - realRoster p = realRoster s - realRoster r) : p = r ∧ q = s

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.firstRoster
statement: noncomputable def firstRoster [Fintype P] (p : P) : Circle := (realRoster p : Circle)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.realRoster_diff_range
statement:
lemma realRoster_diff_range [Fintype P] (p q : P) :
    realRoster q - realRoster p ∈ Set.Ico (-(1 / 8 : ℝ)) (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) + 1)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.firstRoster_diff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma firstRoster_diff_ne_zero [Fintype P] {p q : P} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    firstRoster q - firstRoster p ≠ 0

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.firstRoster_diff_inj
statement:
lemma firstRoster_diff_inj [Fintype P] {p q r s : P} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (h : firstRoster q - firstRoster p = firstRoster s - firstRoster r) : p = r ∧ q = s

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.finite_positive_lower
statement:
lemma finite_positive_lower {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 < f i) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ i, r < f i

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.OffPair
statement: def OffPair (P : Type uP2) := {e : P × P // e.1 ≠ e.2}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.instFintypeOffPair
statement:
noncomputable instance [Fintype P] : Fintype (OffPair P) := by
  classical
  unfold OffPair
  infer_instance

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.firstRoster_parameters
statement:
lemma firstRoster_parameters [Fintype P] :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 100 ∧
      (∀ p q : P, p ≠ q → 16 * ε < ‖firstRoster q - firstRoster p‖) ∧
      (∀ p q r s : P, p ≠ q → r ≠ s → (p, q) ≠ (r, s) →
        16 * ε < ‖(firstRoster q - firstRoster p) - (firstRoster s - firstRoster r)‖)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.norm_difference_perturb
statement:
lemma norm_difference_perturb (p q p' q' : Circle) :
    ‖(q' - p') - (q - p)‖ ≤ ‖q' - q‖ + ‖p' - p‖

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.first_roster_separation
statement:
lemma first_roster_separation {ε η : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hη : η ≤ ε / 2)
    (v v' : P → Circle) (hv' : ∀ p, ‖v' p - v p‖ < η)
    {p q r s : P} (hsep : 16 * ε < ‖(v q - v p) - (v s - v r)‖) :
    12 * ε < ‖(v' q - v' p) - (v' s - v' r)‖

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.first_obstruction_count
statement:
lemma first_obstruction_count [Fintype P] {ε η : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hη : η ≤ ε / 2)
    (v' : P → Circle) (hv' : ∀ p, ‖v' p - firstRoster p‖ < η)
    (hsep : ∀ p q r s : P, p ≠ q → r ≠ s → (p, q) ≠ (r, s) →
      16 * ε < ‖(firstRoster q - firstRoster p) - (firstRoster s - firstRoster r)‖)
    (a : Circle) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : P × P => e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ ‖a + v' e.2 - v' e.1‖ ≤ 6 * ε)).card ≤ 1

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.Forest
statement:
def Forest (P : Type uP3) [DecidableEq P] :=
  {f : Fin 400 → P × P // FreshPairs (List.ofFn f)}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.instFintypeForest
statement:
noncomputable instance [Fintype P] : Fintype (Forest P) := by
  classical
  unfold Forest
  infer_instance

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.Batch
statement: def Batch (P : Type uP4) [DecidableEq P] := Option (Forest P × Bool)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.instFintypeBatch
statement:
noncomputable instance [Fintype P] : Fintype (Batch P) := by
  unfold Batch
  infer_instance

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.batch_card
statement: lemma batch_card [Fintype P] : Fintype.card (Batch P) = 2 * Fintype.card (Forest P) + 1

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.forestRoster
statement:
noncomputable def forestRoster (f : Forest P) : P → Circle :=
  Classical.choose (realize_sequence f.1 f.2 (fun j => (((j : ℝ) / 400 : ℝ) : Circle)))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.forestRoster_spec
statement:
lemma forestRoster_spec (f : Forest P) (j : Fin 400) :
    forestRoster f (f.1 j).2 - forestRoster f (f.1 j).1 = (((j : ℝ) / 400 : ℝ) : Circle)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.batchRoster
statement:
noncomputable def batchRoster (p : P) : Batch P → Circle
  | none => 0
  | some (f, _) => forestRoster f p

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.batch_forest_hit
statement:
lemma batch_forest_hit {η : ℝ} (hη : η ≤ 1 / 1600)
    (v' : P → Batch P → Circle) (hv' : ∀ p c, ‖v' p c - batchRoster p c‖ < η)
    (a : Batch P → Circle) (f : Forest P) :
    ∃ j : Fin 400, ∃ c : Batch P,
      ‖a c + v' (f.1 j).2 c - v' (f.1 j).1 c‖ ≤ 1 / 200

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.batch_obstruction_count
statement:
lemma batch_obstruction_count [Fintype P] {η : ℝ} (hη : η ≤ 1 / 1600)
    (v' : P → Batch P → Circle) (hv' : ∀ p c, ‖v' p c - batchRoster p c‖ < η)
    (a : Batch P → Circle) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : P × P => e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧
      ∀ c : Batch P, 1 / 200 < ‖a c + v' e.2 c - v' e.1 c‖)).card ≤ 4 * 400 ^ 2

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.BlockI
statement:
def BlockI {C : Type uC6} [Fintype C] (s : ℕ) (t : Bool) (x : C → Circle) : Prop :=
  if t then x ∈ TypeTwo s else ∀ c, x c ∈ Near centersI (1 / 16)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.BlockJ
statement:

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.obstructionPairs
statement:
noncomputable def obstructionPairs [Fintype P] {A : Type uA12} {B : Type uB10} {C : Type uC18} (ε : ℝ)
    (a : (A ⊕ (B × C)) → Circle) (v : P → (A ⊕ (B × C)) → Circle) : Finset (P × P) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun e => e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ a + v e.2 - v e.1 ∈ Obstruction ε)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.RobustClock.roster_estimate
statement:
lemma roster_estimate [Fintype P] {A : Type uA13} {B : Type uB11} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    {ε η : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hη : 0 < η) (hηε : η ≤ ε / 2) (hη0 : η ≤ 1 / 1600)
    (hsep : ∀ p q r s : P, p ≠ q → r ≠ s → (p, q) ≠ (r, s) →
      16 * ε < ‖(firstRoster q - firstRoster p) - (firstRoster s - firstRoster r)‖)
    (v' : P → (A ⊕ (B × Batch P)) → Circle)
    (hv' : ∀ p, dist (v' p) (roster p) < η)
    (a : (A ⊕ (B × Batch P)) → Circle) :
    (obstructionPairs ε a v').card ≤
        Fintype.card A + 4 * 400 ^ 2 * Fintype.card B

structure Specification (T : Type uT8) (P : Type uP6) (C : Type uC20) [Fintype T] [Fintype P] [Fintype C] where
  I : T → Set (C → Circle)
  J : T → Set (C → Circle)
  W : Set (C → Circle)
  v : P → C → Circle
  ρ : ℝ
  η : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < ρ
  tolerance_pos : 0 < η
  graph : ∀ z : C → Circle,
    (∀ α lam, (∃ i ∈ I α, ∃ j ∈ J lam, i + j = z) → α = lam) ∨
    ∃ α lam, α ≠ lam ∧ (∃ i ∈ I α, ∃ j ∈ J lam, i + j = z) ∧
      ∀ γ ν, (∃ i ∈ I γ, ∃ j ∈ J ν, i + j = z) → γ = α ∧ ν = lam
  interior : ∀ z : C → Circle, z ∉ W → ∀ α,
    ∃ i : C → Circle, ∀ x, dist x i < ρ → x ∈ I α ∧ z - x ∈ J α
  count : ∀ v' : P → C → Circle, (∀ p, dist (v' p) (v p) < η) →
    ∀ a : C → Circle, ((badPairs W a v').card : ℝ) ≤
      10000000 * Real.log (2 * Fintype.card T)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ScheduleClock.exists_stencil_clock
statement:
theorem exists_stencil_clock {T : Type uT} {C : Type uC4} [Fintype T] [Fintype C]
    (N : ℕ) (S : Specification T (Fin N) C) (B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (r : Fin N → ℤ) (lower : (Fin N → ℤ) → ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∃ (R : ℕ) (p : Fin N → ℤ) (n a : C → ℕ),
      0 < R ∧
      (∀ i, p i % B = r i % B ∧ (2 * (B * R) + 2 : ℤ) < p i) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < j → 2 * p i + (2 * (B * R) + 2 : ℤ) < p j) ∧
      Function.Injective n ∧
      (∀ c, Nat.Prime (n c) ∧ lower p (B * R) < n c ∧ 1 ≤ a c ∧ a c < n c) ∧
      (∀ i, dist (speedMap (fun c => (a c : ℝ) / n c) (p i)) (S.v i) < S.η) ∧
      (∀ v : C → RobustClock.Circle, ∃ j : ℕ, j < R ∧
        dist (speedMap (fun c => (a c : ℝ) / n c) (j * B)) v < S.ρ)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteProduct.cylinderEquiv
statement:
noncomputable def cylinderEquiv (E F : Set (C → S)) (s : Set C)
    (hE : DependsOn E s) (hF : DependsOn F sᶜ) :
    ↥(E ∩ F) × (C → S) ≃ E × F where
  toFun p :=
    (⟨splice s p.1.1 p.2,
      (hE _ _ (splice_eqOn_left _ _ _)).mpr p.1.2.1⟩,
     ⟨splice s p.2 p.1.1,
      (hF _ _ (splice_eqOn_right _ _ _)).mpr p.1.2.2⟩)
  invFun p :=
    (⟨splice s p.1.1 p.2.1,
      ⟨(hE _ _ (splice_eqOn_left _ _ _)).mpr p.1.2,
       (hF _ _ (splice_eqOn_right _ _ _)).mpr p.2.2⟩⟩,
     splice s p.2.1 p.1.1)
  left_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact Subtype.ext (splice_splice _ _ _)
    · exact splice_splice _ _ _
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> exact Subtype.ext (splice_splice _ _ _)

lemma independent_of_disjoint_support [Fintype C] [Fintype S] [DecidableEq C]
    (E F : Set (C → S)) (s t : Set C)
    (hE : DependsOn E s) (hF : DependsOn F t) (hst : Disjoint s t) :
    FiniteAvoidance.mass (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (E ∩ F) *
        FiniteAvoidance.mass (fun _ : C → S => (1 : ℝ)) Set.univ =
      FiniteAvoidance.mass (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) E *
        FiniteAvoidance.mass (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) F

lemma probability_inter [Fintype C] [Fintype S] [DecidableEq C] [Nonempty S]
    (E F : Set (C → S)) (s t : Set C)
    (hE : DependsOn E s) (hF : DependsOn F t) (hst : Disjoint s t) :

      FiniteAvoidance.probability E * FiniteAvoidance.probability F

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteProduct.agreementEquiv
statement:
noncomputable def agreementEquiv (s : Set C) (d : C → S) :
    {β : C → S // Set.EqOn β d s} ≃ (↥(sᶜ) → S) := by
  classical
  exact {
  toFun β c := β.1 c
  invFun γ := ⟨fun c => if h : c ∈ s then d c else γ ⟨c, h⟩, by
    intro c hc
    simp [hc]⟩
  left_inv β := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext c
    dsimp
    split_ifs with hc
    · exact (β.2 hc).symm
    · rfl
  right_inv γ := by
    funext c
    have hc : (c : C) ∉ s := c.2
    simp [hc]
  }

statement:
lemma allEvents_dependsOn {ι : Type uι3} (E : ι → Set (C → S))
    (s : ι → Set C) (hE : ∀ i, DependsOn (E i) (s i)) (J : Finset ι) :
    DependsOn (allEvents E J) (supportUnion s J)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteProduct.probability_allEvents
statement:
lemma probability_allEvents {ι : Type uι4} [Fintype C] [Fintype S]
    [DecidableEq C] [Nonempty S]
    (E : ι → Set (C → S)) (s : ι → Set C)
    (hE : ∀ i, DependsOn (E i) (s i))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (s i) (s j))) (J : Finset ι) :
    FiniteAvoidance.probability (allEvents E J) =
      ∏ i ∈ J, FiniteAvoidance.probability (E i)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteProduct.centeredEquiv
statement:
def centeredEquiv (a : C) : (C → S) ≃ (C → S) where
  toFun β c := if c = a then β c else β c - β a
  invFun γ c := if c = a then γ c else γ c + γ a
  left_inv β := by
    funext c
    by_cases hc : c = a <;> simp [hc]
  right_inv γ := by
    funext c
    by_cases hc : c = a <;> simp [hc]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteProduct.translationEquiv
statement:
def translationEquiv (g : C → S) : (C → S) ≃ (C → S) where
  toFun β c := g c + β c
  invFun γ c := γ c - g c
  left_inv β := by
    funext c
    simp
  right_inv γ := by
    funext c
    simp

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.offLine
statement:
def offLine (a : I → A) (i : I) : Set (I → A) :=
  Set.range (fun b : {b : A // b ≠ a i} => Function.update a i b.1)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.update_ne_center

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.offLine_pairwise

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.card_offLine

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.centered_line_iff
statement:
lemma centered_line_iff {S : Type uS2} [AddCommGroup S] [DecidableEq (I → A)]
    (a : I → A) (γ : (I → A) → S) (i : I) :
    Set.EqOn (FiniteProduct.centeredEquiv a γ) (fun _ => 0) (offLine a i) ↔
      ∀ b : A, γ (Function.update a i b) = γ a

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.starSupport
statement:

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.probability_badEvent

lemma probability_badEvent {S : Type uS5} [AddCommGroup S]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype S]
    (g : (I → A) → S) (a : I → A) :
    FiniteAvoidance.probability (badEvent g a) =

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.CenterCode

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.centerOfCode
statement:
def centerOfCode (a : I → A) : CenterCode I A → (I → A)
  | .inl _ => a
  | .inr (.inl (i, b)) => Function.update a i b
  | .inr (.inr ((i, b), (j, d))) => Function.update (Function.update a i b) j d

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.nearCenters

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.mem_nearCenters

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.card_nearCenters
statement:
lemma card_nearCenters [Fintype I] [Fintype A] (a : I → A) :
    (nearCenters a).card ≤ 1 + Fintype.card I * Fintype.card A +
      (Fintype.card I) ^ 2 * (Fintype.card A) ^ 2
variables: variable {A : Type uA} {I : Type uI} [DecidableEq I]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftCombinatorics.restore_center

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.ShiftTableProperty
statement:
def ShiftTableProperty (l : ℕ) (f : (Fin l → A) → (S →ₗ[K] S))
    (β : (Fin l → A) → S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin l → A) (x : S), ∃ i : Fin l, ∀ b : A,
    f (Function.update a i b) x + β (Function.update a i b) = f a x + β a
variables: variable {A : Type uA3} {K : Type uK} {S : Type uS6} [Field K] [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.exists_shift_table_length
statement:
theorem exists_shift_table_length (a q r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r < 1) :
    ∃ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l ∧
      4 * (q * (1 + l * a + (l : ℝ) ^ 2 * a ^ 2) + 1) * r ^ l ≤ 1
variables: variable {A : Type uA3} {K : Type uK} {S : Type uS6} [Field K] [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.shift_table_at_length
statement:
theorem shift_table_at_length [Fintype A] [Fintype S] [DecidableEq A]
    (l : ℕ)
    (hnum : 4 * ((Fintype.card S : ℝ) *
      (1 + l * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) + (l : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ 2) + 1) *
      (1 - ((Fintype.card S : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card A - 1))⁻¹) ^ l ≤ 1)
    (f : (Fin l → A) → (S →ₗ[K] S)) :
    ∃ β : (Fin l → A) → S, ShiftTableProperty l f β
variables: variable {A : Type uA3} {K : Type uK} {S : Type uS6} [Field K] [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.exists_shift_table
statement:
theorem exists_shift_table [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [Fintype S] :
    ∃ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l ∧ ∀ f : (Fin l → A) → (S →ₗ[K] S),
      ∃ β : (Fin l → A) → S, ShiftTableProperty l f β
variables: variable {A : Type uA3} {K : Type uK} {S : Type uS6} [Field K] [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S]

    (hearly : StrictMono early) (h₀ : early 0=0)
    (hblock : ∀ slot, early slot.1.j.castSucc < p slot ∧ p slot < early slot.1.j.succ)
    (hw₀ : 0≤A.w₀)
    (hvisible : ∀ (f : ℤ → Alphabet) b,
      EpisodeEnd.EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f (lag+A.endRule.offset)
        (A.endRule.small f (lag+A.endRule.offset)) b →
      A.Visible 0 b lag (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) lag))
    (hroster : ∀ (f : ℤ → Alphabet) b,
      EpisodeEnd.EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f (lag+A.endRule.offset)
        (A.endRule.small f (lag+A.endRule.offset)) b → ∀ a i,
      A.Visible (p a) b (SuffixDecoder.origin p lag (p a) i)
        (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (SuffixDecoder.origin p lag (p a) i)))
    (hover : ∀ a, (A.endRule.d:ℤ)^2≤A.endRule.K-|p a-p reference|)
    (hover' : ∀ a, |p a-p reference|<A.endRule.K)
    (hendlast : ∀ (f : ℤ → Alphabet) b,
      EpisodeEnd.EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f (lag+A.endRule.offset)
        (A.endRule.small f (lag+A.endRule.offset)) b → early (Fin.last g')≤b) :
    SplitSound (A.failedDomain lag) (wordUpdate A clock T ρ β early γ lag)
      (prefixLanguage T early γ p) (suffixLanguage A clock T ρ β early p lag reference)

noncomputable instance [Fintype M] [Fintype S] {g B : ℕ} : Fintype (MainTag M S g B) := by
  classical
  apply Fintype.ofInjective (fun t : MainTag M S g B =>
    (⟨t.j, (t.u,t.A,t.C,t.entries,t.input,t.output)⟩ :
      Σ j : Fin g, Fin B × M × M × Omitted M g j × S × S))
  intro a b he
  cases a with | mk aj au aa ac ad ax ay =>
    cases b with | mk bj bu ba bc bd bx byy =>
      have hj : aj = bj := congrArg Sigma.fst he
      subst bj
      have hh : (au,aa,ac,ad,ax,ay) = (bu,ba,bc,bd,bx,byy) :=
        eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp he).2
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hh
      rcases hh with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
      rfl

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SplitMetadata.instFintypeKind
statement:
noncomputable instance [Fintype M] [Fintype S] {g : ℕ} : Fintype (Kind M S K g) := by
  classical
  apply Fintype.ofInjective (fun t : Kind M S K g =>
    (⟨t.j, (t.input,t.output,t.entries, fun a x => t.hypothetical a x)⟩ :
      Σ j : Fin g, S × S × Omitted M g j × (M → S → S)))
  intro a b he
  cases a with | mk aj ax ay ad af =>
    cases b with | mk bj bx byy bd bf =>
      have hj : aj = bj := congrArg Sigma.fst he
      subst bj
      have hh : (ax,ay,ad,fun a x => af a x) = (bx,byy,bd,fun a x => bf a x) :=
        eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp he).2
      have hp := Prod.mk.inj hh
      have hp' := Prod.mk.inj hp.2
      have hp'' := Prod.mk.inj hp'.2
      have hf : af = bf := by
        funext a
        ext x
        exact congrFun (congrFun hp''.2 a) x
      cases hp.1; cases hp'.1; cases hp''.1; cases hf
      rfl

statement:
noncomputable def hypothetical (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (s b t : ℤ) :
    M → (V × K →ₗ[K] V × K) :=
  let q := A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) t
  ClockAffine.hypothetical clock ρ β Tag.input Tag.output (A.φ (q-t))
    (later T f (s+early (Fin.last g')) b (OuterStream.search A f (A.residue (q-t)) t))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.InnerStream.update
statement:
noncomputable def update (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (s b t : ℤ) (x : V × K) : V × K :=
  let ψ := hypothetical A clock T ρ β early f s b t
  let d := fun i : Fin g' => product T f (s+early i.castSucc) (s+early i.succ)
  ObservedInner.table ψ d x + γ ψ d

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.InnerStream.pair_sound
statement:
lemma pair_sound (hearly : StrictMono early) (hearly₀ : early 0=0)
    (hblock : ∀ slot, early slot.1.j.castSucc < p slot ∧ p slot < early slot.1.j.succ)
    (hw : 0 ≤ A.w₀) {s k b b' : ℤ} {f fp fq : ℤ → Alphabet}
    {reference actual decoded : Roster M (V × K) K g' μ}
    (hp : Prefix T early γ p actual fp s k)
    (hq : Suffix A clock T ρ β early p lag reference decoded fq k b')
    (hvis : ∀ i, A.Visible k b (SuffixDecoder.origin p lag k i)
      (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (SuffixDecoder.origin p lag k i)))
    (hover : (A.endRule.d : ℤ)^2 ≤ A.endRule.K-|p actual-p reference|)
    (hover' : |p actual-p reference| < A.endRule.K)
    (hb : s+early (Fin.last g') ≤ b)
    (hend : EpisodeEnd.EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f
      (s+lag+A.endRule.offset) (A.endRule.small f (s+lag+A.endRule.offset)) b)
    (hfailed : A.Failed f (s+lag) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (s+lag)))
    (hprefix : AgreesOn fp f s k) (hsuffix : AgreesOn f fq k (min b b')) :
    decoded=actual ∧ b'=b ∧ update A clock T ρ β early γ f s b (s+lag) actual.1.input = decoded.1.output

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.InnerStream.hypothetical_actual
statement:
lemma hypothetical_actual {f : ℤ → Alphabet} {s b t : ℤ}
    (hsa : s ≤ s+early (Fin.last g')) (hab : s+early (Fin.last g') ≤ b)
    (hstart : ∀ i q, A.inner f i (A.residue (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) t-t)) t=some q →
      s+early (Fin.last g') ≤ q) :
    hypothetical A clock T ρ β early f s b t (product T f s (s+early (Fin.last g'))) =
      Homogenization.lift (ρ (product T f s b))
        (ClockAffine.shift clock ρ β Tag.input Tag.output (A.φ (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) t-t))
          (OuterStream.snapshot A T f s b t))

statement:
structure Test (τ : P → ℤ) (reference : P) (k b : ℤ) (f : ℤ → Alphabet)
    (decoded : P) : Prop where
  visible : ∀ i, A.Visible k b (τ i) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (τ i))
  reference_guard : (∃ i, A.endRule.large f (τ i + A.endRule.offset) = none) →
    (∀ i, A.endRule.small f (τ i + A.endRule.offset) = none) ∧
    EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f (τ reference + A.endRule.offset)
      (A.endRule.small f (τ reference + A.endRule.offset)) b
  unique : A.Failed f (τ decoded) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (τ decoded)) ∧
    ∀ i, A.Failed f (τ i) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (τ i)) → i = decoded
  final_guard : EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f
    (τ decoded + A.endRule.offset) (A.endRule.small f (τ decoded + A.endRule.offset)) b

    (hvis : ∀ i, A.Visible k b (τ i) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (τ i)))
    (he : AgreesOn f g k (min b b')) (i : P) :
    A.endRule.small f (τ i + A.endRule.offset) = A.endRule.small g (τ i + A.endRule.offset) ∧
      A.endRule.large f (τ i + A.endRule.offset) = A.endRule.large g (τ i + A.endRule.offset)

    (he : AgreesOn f g k (min b b'))
    (hover : (A.endRule.d : ℤ)^2 ≤ A.endRule.K - |τ actual - τ reference|)
    (hover' : |τ actual - τ reference| < A.endRule.K)

      (τ actual + A.endRule.offset) (A.endRule.small f (τ actual + A.endRule.offset)) b)

    (hlen : 2 * (d : ℤ) ≤ H + ext)
    (hn : ∀ x, z ≤ x → x ≤ z + H + ext → x ∉ R.markers f) :
    ∃ v : ℤ → Alphabet, (∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a < d ∧ Function.Periodic v (a : ℤ)) ∧
      AgreesOn f v (z + d) (z + H + ext - d + K)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicCuts.fixed_prefix
statement:
lemma fixed_prefix (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) {f v : ℤ → Alphabet}
    {p : ℕ} (hp : Function.Periodic v (p : ℤ)) (s k₀ : ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : s ≤ k₀ - Fintype.card M * p)
    (he : AgreesOn f v (k₀ - Fintype.card M * p)
      (k₀ + (q * (Fintype.card M).factorial : ℕ) * p)) :
    product T f s (k₀ + (q * (Fintype.card M).factorial : ℕ) * p) =
      product T f s k₀

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.PeriodicCuts.progression
statement:
lemma progression {B n R d K : ℕ} {r h : ℤ}
    (S : IntegerSchedules.Inner B n R (Fintype.card M) d K r h)
    (rule : Rule Alphabet d K) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hK : 3*d^2 < K)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hB : 0 < B) (hn : 0 < n)
    (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (s z : ℤ) (u : Fin B)
    (hs : s ≤ z + d)
    (hnomarker : ∀ x, z ≤ x → x ≤ z + S.H u + S.extension → x ∉ rule.markers f) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ p < d ∧
      ∀ a : ℕ, a < n →
        a * p * (Fintype.card M).factorial < n * d * (Fintype.card M).factorial ∧
        product T f s (z + S.H u + S.lag + (a*p*(Fintype.card M).factorial*B : ℕ)) =
          product T f s (z + S.H u + S.lag)

    (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (reference : Kind × Fin μ) (kind : Kind)
    (hbad : (A.bad p f (s+lag) (b-A.endRule.tail)).card < μ)
    (hvis : ∀ a i, A.Visible (s+p a) b (s+lag+(p a-p i))
      (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (s+lag+(p a-p i))))
    (hnear : ∀ i j, |p i-p j| ≤ H)
    (hnest : (A.endRule.d : ℤ)+(A.endRule.B-1)*A.endRule.S+H ≤ 3*A.endRule.d)
    (hover : (A.endRule.d : ℤ)^2 ≤ A.endRule.K-H)
    (hover' : H < A.endRule.K)
    (hend : EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f
      (s+lag+A.endRule.offset) (A.endRule.small f (s+lag+A.endRule.offset)) b)
    (hfailed : A.Failed f (s+lag) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (s+lag))) :
    ∃ copy : Fin μ, Test A (origin p lag (s+p (kind,copy))) reference
      (s+p (kind,copy)) b f (kind,copy)

statement:
lemma exists_avoiding [Nonempty Ω] [Fintype ι] (E : ι → Set Ω)
    (h : ∑ i, probability (E i) < 1) : ∃ x, ∀ i, x ∉ E i
variables: variable {Ω : Type uΩ} {ι : Type uι} [Fintype Ω]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.Feasible
statement: def Feasible (a l g n : T) : Prop := a ≠ l ∧ ({a, l} : Finset T) ≠ {g, n}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.Satisfies
statement:
def Satisfies (a l g n : T) (p : T → Bool) : Prop :=
  p a = false ∧ p l = true ∧ p g = p n

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.feasible_partition
statement:
lemma feasible_partition {a l g n : T} (h : Feasible a l g n) :
    ∃ p : T → Bool, Satisfies a l g n p

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.repetitions
statement: noncomputable def repetitions (m : ℕ) : ℕ := ⌈64 * Real.log (2 * m)⌉₊

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.repetitions_estimate
statement:
lemma repetitions_estimate {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (m : ℝ) ^ 4 * ((15 : ℝ) / 16) ^ repetitions m ≤ 1 / 16

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.repetitions_bound
statement:
lemma repetitions_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (repetitions m : ℝ) ≤ 66 * Real.log (2 * m)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.repetitions_pos
statement: lemma repetitions_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : 0 < repetitions m

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.probability_satisfies
statement:
lemma probability_satisfies [Fintype T] (N : ℕ) (i : Fin N)
    {a l g n : T} (h : Feasible a l g n) :
    1 / 16 ≤ FiniteAvoidance.probability
      {β : (Fin N × T) → Bool | Satisfies a l g n (fun t => β (i, t))}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.satisfies_depends
OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.probability_failure
statement:
lemma probability_failure [Fintype T] (N : ℕ) {a l g n : T}
    (h : Feasible a l g n) :
    FiniteAvoidance.probability
      {β : (Fin N × T) → Bool | ∀ i, ¬ Satisfies a l g n (fun t => β (i, t))} ≤
      ((15 : ℝ) / 16) ^ N

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.exists_partitions
statement:
theorem exists_partitions [Fintype T] [Nonempty T] :
    ∃ p : Fin (repetitions (Fintype.card T)) → T → Bool,
      ∀ a l g n, Feasible a l g n → ∃ i,
        Satisfies a l g n (p i)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.typeCount
statement: noncomputable def typeCount (m : ℕ) : ℕ := ⌈Real.log m / Real.log 2⌉₊

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.card_le_binary
statement: lemma card_le_binary {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : m ≤ 2 ^ typeCount m

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.typeCount_bound
statement:
lemma typeCount_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (typeCount m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (2 * m)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.exists_types
statement:
lemma exists_types [Fintype T] [Nonempty T] :
    ∃ p : Fin (typeCount (Fintype.card T)) → T → Bool,
      ∀ a l, a ≠ l → ∃ i, p i a ≠ p i l

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.TagPartitions.total_count_bound
statement:
lemma total_count_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ((repetitions m + 4 * 400 ^ 2 * typeCount m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      10000000 * Real.log (2 * m)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.shift
statement: def shift (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (a : ℤ) : ℤ → Alphabet := fun x => f (x-a)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.shift_add
statement: @[simp] lemma shift_add (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (a x : ℤ) : shift f a (x+a)=f x

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.map_injective
statement: lemma map_injective (a : ℤ) : Function.Injective (Option.map (fun x : ℤ => x+a))

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.map_none
statement: lemma map_none (a : ℤ) (x : Option ℤ) : x.map (fun x => x+a)=none ↔ x=none

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.realizes
statement:
lemma realizes {w : List Alphabet} {f : ℤ → Alphabet} {s : ℤ}
    (hf : Realizes w s f) (a : ℤ) : Realizes w (s+a) (shift f a)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.piece
statement:
lemma piece (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (s t a : ℤ) :
    WordIntervals.piece (shift f a) (s+a) (t+a)=WordIntervals.piece f s t

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.product
statement:
lemma product {M : Type uM} [Monoid M] (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M)
    (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (s t a : ℤ) :
    WordIntervals.product T (shift f a) (s+a) (t+a)=WordIntervals.product T f s t

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.markers
statement:
lemma markers {d K : ℕ} (R : Rule Alphabet d K) (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (a x : ℤ) :
    x∈R.markers (shift f a) ↔ x-a∈R.markers f

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.marker_search
statement:
lemma marker_search {S S' : Set ℤ} (a : ℤ) (hS : ∀ x, x∈S' ↔ x-a∈S) (l r : ℤ) :
    MarkerSearch.search S' (l+a) (r+a)=(MarkerSearch.search S l r).map (fun x => x+a)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.end_search
statement:
lemma end_search {S S' : Set ℤ} (a : ℤ) (hS : ∀ x, x∈S' ↔ x-a∈S)
    {B D : ℤ} (hB : 0<B) (hD : 0≤D) (c z : ℤ) :
    EndSearch.search S' B D c (z+a)=(EndSearch.search S B D c z).map (fun x => x+a)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.agrees
statement:
lemma agrees {f v : ℤ → Alphabet} {s b : ℤ} (hf : AgreesOn f v s b) (a : ℤ) :
    AgreesOn (shift f a) (shift v a) (s+a) (b+a)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.StreamShift.unstable

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.Early.outer_available
statement:
lemma outer_available
    (hβ : ∀ a c, ShiftTableProperty g (ClockAffine.productTable ρ a c) (β a c))
    {f : ℤ → Alphabet} {s b reference : ℤ}
    (hr : reference ∈ (S.cuts g).offsets)
    (he : EpisodeEnd.EndAt L.endRule.d L.endRule.K L.endRule.tail f
      (s+L.lag+L.endRule.offset) (L.endRule.small f (s+L.lag+L.endRule.offset)) b)
    (hn : ¬(S.parameters g L hB).Failed f (s+L.lag)
      ((S.parameters g L hB).anchor f (b-L.endRule.tail) (s+L.lag))) (x : V) :
    ∃ (tag : Tag M V g B) (k : ℤ), tag.input=x ∧
      OuterStream.Prefix (S.parameters g L hB) (S.cuts g) clock T ρ β tag f s (s+L.lag) k ∧
      OuterStream.Suffix (S.parameters g L hB) (S.cuts g) clock T ρ reference tag f k b ∧
      tag.output=OuterStream.update (S.parameters g L hB) clock T ρ β f s b (s+L.lag) x
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet} {M : Type uM} {V : Type uV} {K : Type uK} {P : Type uP} {C : Type uC} [Monoid M] [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.InnerStream.available
statement:
lemma available
    (hγ : ∀ ψ, ShiftTableProperty g' (ObservedInner.table ψ) (γ ψ))
    {s b H : ℤ} {f : ℤ → Alphabet} (reference : Roster M (V × K) K g' μ)
    (hbad : (A.bad p f (s+lag) (b-A.endRule.tail)).card < μ)
    (hvis : ∀ a i, A.Visible (s+p a) b (s+lag+(p a-p i))
      (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (s+lag+(p a-p i))))
    (hnear : ∀ i j, |p i-p j| ≤ H)
    (hnest : (A.endRule.d : ℤ)+(A.endRule.B-1)*A.endRule.S+H ≤ 3*A.endRule.d)
    (hover : (A.endRule.d : ℤ)^2 ≤ A.endRule.K-H) (hover' : H<A.endRule.K)
    (hend : EpisodeEnd.EndAt A.endRule.d A.endRule.K A.endRule.tail f
      (s+lag+A.endRule.offset) (A.endRule.small f (s+lag+A.endRule.offset)) b)
    (hfailed : A.Failed f (s+lag) (A.anchor f (b-A.endRule.tail) (s+lag))) (x : V × K) :
    ∃ (slot : Roster M (V × K) K g' μ) (k : ℤ), slot.1.input=x ∧
      Prefix T early γ p slot f s k ∧
      Suffix A clock T ρ β early p lag reference slot f k b ∧
      slot.1.output=update A clock T ρ β early γ f s b (s+lag) x
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet2} {M : Type uM2} {V : Type uV2} {K : Type uK2} {P : Type uP2} {C : Type uC2} [Monoid M] [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.Late.count_margins
statement:
lemma count_margins (hB : 0<B) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hw : 0 ≤ w) :
    2*h+2*w<L.endRule.S ∧
    2*h+((B:ℤ)-1)*L.endRule.S+2*w<L.endRule.d ∧
    2*h+2*((B:ℤ)-1)*L.endRule.S<L.endRule.d
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet3} {B : ℕ} {h w E earlyLast : ℤ}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.Late.decoder_margins
statement:
lemma decoder_margins (hB : 0<B) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hw : 0 ≤ w) :
    (L.endRule.d:ℤ)+(L.endRule.B-1)*L.endRule.S+h ≤ 3*L.endRule.d ∧
    (L.endRule.d:ℤ)^2 ≤ L.endRule.K-h ∧ h<L.endRule.K
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet3} {B : ℕ} {h w E earlyLast : ℤ}

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.Early.full_bad_card
statement:
lemma full_bad_card
    (hmod : ∀ i j i' j', i ≠ j → i' ≠ j' → (i,j) ≠ (i',j') →
      (reserved i-reserved j)%B ≠ (reserved i'-reserved j')%B)
    (μ : ℕ) (hμ : 20*(10000000*Real.log (2*Fintype.card T)+4*(g+1))+10<μ)
    (f : ℤ → Alphabet) (t q₀ : ℤ) :
    ((S.parameters g L hB).bad S.p f t q₀).card<μ
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet4} {T : Type uT} {P : Type uP3} {C : Type uC3} [Fintype T] [Fintype P] [Fintype C]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.Early.roster_visible
statement:
lemma roster_visible {f : ℤ → Alphabet} {s b : ℤ}
    (he : EpisodeEnd.EndAt L.endRule.d L.endRule.K L.endRule.tail f
      (s+L.lag+L.endRule.offset) (L.endRule.small f (s+L.lag+L.endRule.offset)) b)
    (a i : Roster M (V × K) K g' μ) :
    (S.parameters g L hB).Visible (s+S.p a) b (s+L.lag+(S.p a-S.p i))
      ((S.parameters g L hB).anchor f (b-L.endRule.tail) (s+L.lag+(S.p a-S.p i)))
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet5} {M : Type uM3} {V : Type uV3} {K : Type uK3} {C : Type uC4} [Monoid M] [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.Early.inner_available
statement:
lemma inner_available
    (hmod : ∀ i j i' j', i ≠ j → i' ≠ j' → (i,j) ≠ (i',j') →
      (reserved i-reserved j)%B ≠ (reserved i'-reserved j')%B)
    (hμ : 20*(10000000*Real.log (2*Fintype.card (Tag M V g B))+4*(g+1))+10<μ)
    (hγ : ∀ ψ, ShiftTableProperty g' (ObservedInner.table ψ) (γ ψ))
    {f : ℤ → Alphabet} {s b : ℤ} (reference : Roster M (V × K) K g' μ)
    (he : EpisodeEnd.EndAt L.endRule.d L.endRule.K L.endRule.tail f
      (s+L.lag+L.endRule.offset) (L.endRule.small f (s+L.lag+L.endRule.offset)) b)
    (hf : (S.parameters g L hB).Failed f (s+L.lag)
      ((S.parameters g L hB).anchor f (b-L.endRule.tail) (s+L.lag))) (x : V × K) :
    ∃ (slot : Roster M (V × K) K g' μ) (k : ℤ), slot.1.input=x ∧
      InnerStream.Prefix T S.β γ S.p slot f s k ∧
      InnerStream.Suffix (S.parameters g L hB) clock T ρ β S.β S.p L.lag reference slot f k b ∧
      slot.1.output=InnerStream.update (S.parameters g L hB) clock T ρ β S.β γ f s b (s+L.lag) x
variables: variable {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet5} {M : Type uM3} {V : Type uV3} {K : Type uK3} {C : Type uC4} [Monoid M] [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.slotIndex
statement: noncomputable def slotIndex (p : P) : ℤ := ((Fintype.equivFin P) p).val+1

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.reserved

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.slotModulus

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.slotIndex_bounds

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.slotIndex_injective
statement: lemma slotIndex_injective : Function.Injective (slotIndex P)

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.reserved_distinct
statement:
lemma reserved_distinct (i j i' j' : P) (hij : i ≠ j) (hij' : i' ≠ j')
    (hn : (i,j) ≠ (i',j')) :
    (reserved P i-reserved P j)%slotModulus P ≠
      (reserved P i'-reserved P j')%slotModulus P

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SlotResidues.slotModulus_pos
statement: lemma slotModulus_pos : 0<slotModulus P

name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.OuterStream.update_congr
statement:
lemma update_congr {f f' : ℤ → Alphabet} {s b t : ℤ} (hs : s≤b)
    (he : AgreesOn f f' s b) (hw₀ : 0≤A.w₀)
